name: nocodehack
description: Makes 9:16 animated Roblox-style YouTube Shorts in Blender from one prompt: story, checks, camera, VFX, voices, and sound.
suggestedPrompts: use the nocodehack skill to set up and fill the Roblox Studio libraries
use the nocodehack skill to make a Short about a kid who tries to hide a bad grade from his mom
use the nocodehack skill to make a POV Short where you're the new kid at school
